final: WITH g AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS n FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), s AS (SELECT powerstatus, n, n*1.0/(SELECT SUM(n) FROM g) AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.n) AS total_telescopes, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
